overclaims: The plain reading is that, at the time, paying demand for generative AI was too small to cover the cost of building and running it, so the leading firms depended on outside capital.
Even the market leader's 2024 revenue fell far short of its costs, and it was raising new outside funding (same article), so demand did not pay for operations.
checks.note: The rationale preserves the forecast qualification, but e2's explanation presents expected losses as established results. The interpretation also asserts funding dependence across leading firms, which the evidence does not establish. The limitations acknowledge this gap but do not remove the assertions elsewhere.

The Stanford statistic omits its comparison group in both the rationale and evidence excerpt. The reported 13 percent relative employment decline was compared with occupations more insulated from AI. Include that comparison to make the metric clear.
